name: Innocorp Limited
about: Innocorp Limited manufactures injection molded plastic products for household and industrial uses in India. It also engages in the manufacturing of water cooler components; containers for packaging suppliers; and molded furniture, such as chairs, tables, and stools, as well as vegetable crates and pallets. The company was formerly known as Innosoft Technologies Limited and changed its name to Innocorp Limited in September 2006. Innocorp Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
